import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
declare global {
  var counter: number;
}
function read() {
  return counter;
}
counter = 3;
const point = Object.freeze({ x: 1 });
(point as { x: number }).x = 2;
console.log(read(), point.x, typeof readFileSync, (function (this: unknown) { return this === undefined; })());
